description: Get the user's CURRENT subscription plan and how it is billed. Returns hasLiveSubscription, status (TRIALING/PENDING_FIRST_CHARGE/ACTIVE/PAST_DUE/CANCELLED), planType (STANDARD/PREMIUM/ULTRA), billingProvider (ONCHAIN/STRIPE/APP_STORE/PLAY_STORE), billedTo ('balance' | 'card' | 'app_store'; app_store plans are cancelled or changed in the user's Apple or Google account settings, not in Moneda), balanceFundsRenewal (true only for ONCHAIN — a non-zero stablecoin balance is needed for the next renewal; false for STRIPE card plans, where the wallet balance is irrelevant), currency, billingPeriod, periodEnd, cancelledAt. Use this before advising on a low/zero balance: a 0 balance only threatens the subscription when balanceFundsRenewal is true.
name: get_current_subscription
